goal: Present eight Arabic personality-discovery questions as single-select multiple-choice (MCQ) cards within the pirate parchment interface; capture exactly one selected option per question.

screenshot_composition.background: Very dark wooden cabin with warm hanging lantern at top edges, a little sail/map in bottom-right.
screenshot_composition.top: Arabic question counter above circular progress line.
screenshot_composition.center: Large torn parchment question text on left with orange pirate captain illustration overlapping the right side of parchment but not covering main question.
screenshot_composition.answers: Four cream beveled rectangular choices stacked vertically, each with colored icon on image-left and dark Arabic text.
screenshot_composition.footer: Dark outlined previous button bottom left, bright red next button bottom right.

reference_example.question_text: يواجه فريقك مشكلة في المنصة الجامعية التي يستخدمها مئات الطلاب ما هو أول شيء تفكر في القيام به؟

visible_answers.text: أبني حلاً تقنياً موثوقاً يصلح المشكلة من جذورها.
أستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي لتقديم حلول ذكية ومبتكرة.
أصمم واجهة سهلة الاستخدام تجعل التجربة أفضل للطلاب.
أحلل البيانات لأفهم سبب المشكلة وأجد الأنماط فيها.

reference_example.reference_inconsistency: Counter says question 3 of 8, but illustrated dots appear fewer than eight; implementation should show 8 steps if count is eight. Cybersecurity is not represented among this example question options; do not infer a rule from this one question.

shared_visual_parts.style: Cream torn irregular scroll, distressed corners
shared_visual_parts.art_overhang: Orange captain visually overlaps parchment right edge on screenshot, but text area must have protected inset

next.action: validate current answer and go next/submit

mobile_layout.lanterns: Two lanterns near top with adequate safe-area spacing; set decorative pointer-events none
mobile_layout.question_panel: Full width; variable height. On smaller viewports position pirate to top-right or just below parchment so it does not cover Arabic text.
mobile_layout.answers: Four full-width minimum-68px option cards stacked with 10–12px gap; keep each card selectable, allow multiline Arabic labels, and display selection clearly.
mobile_layout.buttons: Two equally accessible bottom buttons within page flow (may sticky bottom with safe-area padding); no fixed covering of answer controls.
mobile_layout.overflow: Allow vertical scrolling on short screens and with large text; keep all four options and action buttons reachable without overlapping fixed illustrations.

desktop_layout.center: Quiz occupies focused narrow panel on broad background; parchment and pirate remain foreground focal points.

validation_and_accessibility: Use a semantic fieldset/legend and four native radio inputs (styled as selectable parchment cards).
Only one answer may be selected per question; each option is keyboard and touch accessible.
Disable Next until an option is selected; allow users to change selection before submitting.
Announce question changes using focus to the question heading or aria-live.
Returning to a previous question must restore its selected option.
Hide decorative pirate images and lanterns from screen readers; respect RTL and 44px minimum touch targets.
Do not hardcode questions 1, 2, or 4–8 from the screenshot; mark them awaiting the approved question bank.

interaction.option_source: Approved Arabic question-bank data; do not fabricate unsupplied questions.
interaction.layout: Four tall parchment option cards in a vertical column as shown in the screenshot; each option has a distinctive circular track/icon accent and right-aligned Arabic RTL label.

selection_behavior.on_select: Set responses[currentQuestionId].optionId to tapped optionId, deselect previous selection, and reveal a distinct selected style.
selection_behavior.selected_style: Visible crimson/gold or current accent outline, slight raised pixel-frame, optional check icon; preserve contrast and avoid relying on color alone.
selection_behavior.on_reselect: Allow changing the answer until submitted.
selection_behavior.accessibility: Use fieldset/legend and native radio inputs styled as cards (or equivalent accessible radiogroup/radio with keyboard arrow navigation). Label entire card as a touch target.

navigation.final_action: When all eight questions have valid optionIds, submit only approved structured responses to the provided analysis/scoring interface and navigate to /loading.
navigation.no_scoring_implementation: Do not invent track weights, AI behavior, or inferred personality result.

interaction.persist: Store one {questionId, optionId} pair per question within the active quiz session.
